primary_references.actual_reading_scope: Parameter identifiability from null-space of a sufficiently rich data matrix, browser line 87; exact small regression authored separately.

bounded_reading_limits: Only stated browser passages and listed local instructional sections were inspected. Accessibility, a search title or a downloaded file was not treated as full reading.
The initial baseline read output was truncated; later bounded actual source passages were inspected. No full-catalogue line-by-line reading is claimed.

PubMed 12972395 returned only a vulnerability-disclosure shell on open; that paper is not a used full reading. The actual Scheller/Nardini abstract is used only for careful comparator choice; covariance optimization is independently derived.

UNB arithmetic page illustrates interval refinement but contains numerical inconsistencies outside the example adopted here. Its quoted example numbers and integer coder are not reproduced; the authored rational interval case is calculated independently.
No full external copyrighted source bodies are retained in shipped author evidence.

novelty_rejection.original: Unrestricted controllability-rank example with the double integrator.
novelty_rejection.reason: Actual MAT024 section 6 already teaches the same matrix and rank test. A new target pair alone would be a renamed fixture.
novelty_rejection.correction: New operation enumerates a bounded finite command alphabet for a target/horizon and minimizes squared command energy. The control retains rank two but becomes infeasible at a shorter horizon.
novelty_rejection.outcome: Author structural/arithmetic checks pass after content correction; independent review remains pending.

catalogue_search_limits: concept-mentions.json is an exact text-mention audit, not a semantic completeness proof. Chromatic musical mentions are false positives for graph coloring; Pareto distributions are distinct from Pareto dominance. Actual MAT024 controllability passage was read after its relevant hit.
omissions: No runnable production engine, API or DSL was added.
No human, fluent-language, learner, native runtime, physical material, production adoption or publication decision was accepted.
